acceptance.given: A replay Matrix is assembled from the repository v2 matrix fixture and invoked through the repository-owned replay entry point.

oracle.expected: The aggregate contains independently executed valid-package, invalid-package, historical-compatibility, dirty-baseline, knowledge-read-set-collision, and closed-policy-architecture-index-gap cases; each case carries and satisfies its required semantic condition, rather than merely a distinct label, hash, or fixture.
forbidden: A required named case is absent, renamed into an unlabeled equivalent, or accepted solely because its category label, hash, or fixture differs.
A dirty-baseline, knowledge-collision, or closed-policy/index-gap case passes without detecting its respective condition.
The aggregate reports success when any named case lacks its required semantic distinction.
oracle.observable: The replay-matrix receipt’s per-case execution records and the matrix fixture’s case-specific semantic conditions.

acceptance.then: The six closed Matrix Case semantic distinctions are enforced before the aggregate may succeed.
acceptance.when: The replay Matrix is assembled or validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing matrix replay test with one named case’s required semantic condition removed, relabelled, or replaced by label/hash-only distinctness; the real replay validation must reject the aggregate.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the repository-owned replay matrix enforce the closed set of six named semantic case types—valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap—and reject label-, hash-, or fixture-only substitutes that do not implement the corresponding semantic condition.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain the existing jimuyun.stable-candidate-replay-matrix.v2 identity, six-case closed matrix shape, repository-relative targets, and authorizes: []; add only case-level semantics needed to distinguish the six required behaviors.

slice_hint.state_transition: A matrix that can pass with category-only cases transitions to a matrix whose aggregate success is gated on independently executed, semantically distinct implementations of all six named cases.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The replay-matrix aggregate succeeds only if exactly the six required named semantic distinctions are present, independently executed, and semantically satisfied; a missing, relabelled, or label/hash/fixture-only substitute produces an unsuccessful aggregate.
